art_direction: 灰白底、淡灰紫双眉和短黑横嘴；两眼虹膜由左向右柔和流过珊瑚红、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫，自信放松。
composition_variation: A calm, self-possessed gaze toward the viewer. Keep the viewer-left eye lower and rising toward the central gap; the viewer-right eye stays higher and broad. Slightly lower the upper lids, with relaxed small pale brows. The short mouth stays level. Confident and easygoing, never hostile.
iris_color_mode: continuous soft gradient in both whole iris openings
transition_softness: Broad overlapping color transitions with no visible boundaries, bands, strips or blocks; smooth continuous pigment blend.
gradient_scope: One continuous gradient across the entire iris opening behind each pupil; no restart in either visible side patch.
